about: Version 2, final cut (user, 2026-10-22): the app grid through a blur with a push onto the Utilities folder; the dock menu straight into the search (no Settings clip); Now Playing (the user's Spotify playing "Hey Ladies", Beastie Boys; tools/showcase/screensaver-video.sh NPV_SPOTIFY=1), the lock screen recorded in the same minute, the desktop, the title. Round 2: the widget-to-menu and files-to-folder takes (extra4) replace the widget, calendar, Files and grid clips.

clips.name: home-to-widget
clips.where: a hard cut from the title on the same home-screen frame; the camera pushes in onto the cursor; the clock set down beside Weather; ends once it has settled

clips.name: quick-settings
clips.where: top right: the panel grows from its icon, the Wi-Fi submenu

clips.name: widget-to-menu
clips.where: one take (user, 2026-10-22): right-click the wallpaper, Add Widget, the clock drops in; the cursor rises to the date, the calendar grows out of it and glides into quick settings

clips.name: files-drag
clips.where: one take (user, 2026-10-22): the Files window dragged, closed with Ctrl+W, the cursor down to the dock as the camera pulls back

clips.name: app-grid
clips.where: the grid button clicked, the grid opens whole, the cursor goes up to Utilities, the folder opens under the click and closes (user, 2026-10-22: no zoom here; cut before the recording goes black at 12.1)

clips.name: dock-menu
clips.where: bottom: Files in the dock, its name label, its menu; the menu closes and the camera pulls back as the cursor rises

clips.name: search
clips.where: straight from the dock menu: the overview opens, the cursor clicks the search bar, types calc, the results pop up, and it closes back to the home screen

clips.name: screensaver-enter
clips.where: whole screen: Now Playing opens over the desktop through a blur; a drop of glass falls and forms the cover

clips.name: screensaver-tilt
clips.where: the cover, the camera still on it: the cursor tilts it, its rim glints

clips.name: screensaver-next
clips.where: whole screen: the lyrics, then Next: the next song on Paul's Boutique

clips.name: lock
clips.where: the lock screen through a blur, the same minute on its clock; the Now Playing card and the sign-in fade in at once, the password typed, unlocked (user, 2026-10-22: no pause before the card)

clips.name: home
clips.where: back to the desktop through a blur, then the title
